note: Owner-interactive manual smoke cases. Verify triggering, relevant-seat selection, sourced persona takes, owner option cards, and explicit sign-off.

evals.prompt: Run a design council for a persistent lead agent that may automatically repair its own orchestration system.
evals.expected_output: A relevant subset including Data, La Forge, Worf, Troi, and O'Brien grounds claims in repository decisions, surfaces autonomy versus safety conflicts, walks owner decisions, and drafts a repository-conforming specification without implementation planning.

evals.prompt: Ich möchte einen technischen Kurs um praktische Übungen ergänzen. Lass den Design Council die Anforderungen mit mir entwickeln.
evals.expected_output: The generic workflow adapts outside software implementation, selects human-experience, evidence, context, and delivery perspectives, converses in German, and produces acceptance focused on learner outcomes rather than code files.

evals.prompt: I want one agent platform for every project, every team, every provider, and every operating system. Design the whole thing.
evals.expected_output: Intake recognizes that the route and destination exceed one council session, recommends wayfinding rather than manufacturing a complete spec, and publishes nothing unless the owner explicitly chooses a durable next step.
